field.name: RequirementIds.parse result
field.type: { date: string; hash8: string; story?: number | undefined; fr: number } | undefined
field.purpose: SUPERSEDES the return type of RequirementIds.parse declared in this sketch ({ epicHash; ordinal; storyId? }): a stored requirement id carries only the date and the first 8 hash characters, so parse returns these parts, story and fr as numbers

rationale: The sc1 sketch cannot be implemented from stored requirement ids: they contain no full epic hash. The existing parseFrId result is what its tests and callers rely on.
